articleTitle: Optimization design of vehicle borne radar pedestal
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In order to satisfy the performance index of some high-mobility vehicle borne radar pedestal system, weight-reduction design was studied by three aspects: one-in-whole design, material alternation and structure optimization. Result showed that weight index could be obtained by adopting aluminum alloy material and structure optimization, and related result could give reference to the other similar structure design.

articleTitle: Research on vertical wind speed's influence on acoustic parametric array sound field
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In this paper, it is investigated that how vertical wind speed affects acoustic parametric array sound field by theoretical derivation and analysis. It is proved that sound pressure distribution of acoustic parametric array acoustic field by experiment test, and the influence on the sound pressure distribution under different wind speed is analyzed. Moreover, corresponding experiments have been done, and the results show that wind speed has no effect on basic sound pressure of sound wave, but will affect the spread direction of sound field. Vertical wind speed can make the sound pressure distribution curve in the cross-section perpendicular to the sound propagation direction move along the wind speed direction for a certain offset distance. The bigger the wind speed is, the greater the offset distance will be. It is significant in revealing the influence of wind speed on the acoustic field of parametric array.

Author Keywords: influence on the sound pressure distribution

articleTitle: Application of AGV in intelligent logistics system
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: AGV, a flexible and intelligent logistics handling robot, as intelligent logistics equipment, has been widely used in material handling, assembly lines and other occasions. The components, communication and guiding principle of the AGV system, were introduced, and the logistics distribution model of AGV was analyzed, which provided a reference on the applications for AGV in discrete manufacturing process.

articleTitle: Bionic mechanism and kinetic characteristic for quadruped robot dog
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Taking the dog for prototype, this paper mainly study the bionic mechanism and kinetic characteristic for quadruped robot dog. Inspired from the physical structure and movement patterns of mammals, establish the model of quadruped robot dog with scapula and biarticular muscle which has the characteristics of bionic structure and simple control. Combined with the foot motion characteristics of mammals, use interpolation method to fit the trajectory curve of foot and achieve the mapping form foot Cartesian space to joint space through the kinematic analysis. Apply the joint angle relationship to carry out the motion simulation under the environment of ADAMS. It is proved that the feasibility of the bionic mechanism which uses the bionic gait and it makes the foundation for designing the bionic mechanism of quadruped robot dog with compliant structure.

articleTitle: Thickness profile design of airborne radomes with thickness control
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The streamlined shapes of airborne radomes tend to cause severe degradation of the electromagnetic (EM) performance, which can be compensated by properly designing the thickness profile of the radome. However, the obtained thickness profile may vary dramatically in the entire range of the radome, which would impose great difficulties on manufacturing. In this paper, thickness control is introduced in the optimization process to deal with this problem. The design variables are the thickness value of several discrete points along the radome central axis, from which the thickness profile are obtained through B-spline interpolation. The thickness control is realized through including the variance of the design variables as a new optimization objective. A tangent ogival radome is employed for simulation and the results are discussed. The obtained new radome design can be more easily fabricated than the traditional variable thickness one.

articleTitle: Feature selection method of vehicle detection by using PLS Hough Transform
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper proposes extended Generalized Hough Transform (GHT) to introduce training process by using Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression analysis. In this study, we introduced training process to determine the voting weight of GHT by using PLS regression analysis. Thereby, it becomes possible to generic object detection, while maintaining the framework of Hough-based object detection. In this paper, we applied PLS Hough transform to the vehicle detection from satellite images. Then, powerful feature selection analysis methods are employed to improve the performance by reducing the number of features.

articleTitle: Performance of planar arrays for microwave power transmission with phase shifter errors
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper proposes a method based on statistical analysis to analyze the influence of phase shifter errors on microwave power transmission (MPT) efficiency of planar phased array antenna. Through probability theory, the effect of phase shifter errors on the average beam collection efficiency (BCE) with arbitrary shape is derived, which exactly illustrates how the phase shifter errors affect the average beam collection efficiency. Representative examples are reported and discussed to verify the obtained influence relationship.

articleTitle: New exoskeleton structure and control algorithm considering walking characteristics
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Walking assistive device is gaining attention, because of aging society these days. To assist their rehabilitation and realize their independent walk, the field of wearable device, such as exoskeleton is being researched. This paper mainly focuses on the device for patients with mild hemiplegia, caused by stroke. Many walking assistive devices were researched so far. However, these devices restrict patients' natural motion due to the structure of the device. Moreover, conventional control system has not satisfied the balance between assistance and patients' will. Therefore, the mechanism of new assistive device which reduce the restriction of the knee joint is proposed. This exoskeleton lifts up their lower limb by one link and impedance control considering the walking characteristics of the patient are also proposed. The controller focuses on the walking phase, floor reaction force and reaction force of each joint. After discussing walking characteristics of healthy person and patient with hemiplegia, proposed control is introduced. Effectiveness of proposed exoskeleton is confirmed by simulation.

articleTitle: 3D printing monitoring platform based on the Internet of things
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: 3D printing is a kind of direct manufacturing technology, based on digital model files which can make almost any shape of 3D entities. Nowadays, this technology has been used in jewelry, footwear, industrial design, architecture, engineering, education, geographic information system and other fields. There is no doubt that 3D printing will bring a revolutionary impact on manufacturing. With the rapid development of 3D printing industry, in a global environment, it becomes possible to build different 3D printing processing platforms in different areas. Aiming at ensure the stability and the effectiveness of massive 3D printers in wide-area environment, 3D printing operation condition monitoring platform, based on the Internet of things, is proposed. The key technologies in the platform, like various ways of information collection, the Internet of things and information transmission of massive 3D printers and the construction of a remote monitoring center, are described in detail. Through the instance of small 3D printing processing workshops, the Internet of things as well as the remote monitoring of many 3D printers is realized, which verifies the validity of the scheme. It has great significance to improve efficiency and realize the global 3D printing condition monitoring and remote diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on the anti-noise performance of Doppler frequency estimation algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The anti-noise Doppler frequency estimation algorithm was studied in this paper. This paper focuses on the complex correlation of Doppler frequency estimation algorithm, and compares the anti-noise performance of narrowband signals and broadband signals, illustrating the anti-noise performance of broadband signals is better than the anti-noise performance of narrowband signals. In addition, this paper shows the longer the length of the m-sequence is, the better is anti-noise performance. Meanwhile the anti-noise performance of Walsh sequence is better than that of m-sequence; finally, the anti-noise performance of the Gold sequence is better than that of m-sequence when both sequences are the same order; the anti-noise performance of improved Walsh sequence is better than that of the original Walsh sequence.

articleTitle: Pattern tolerance analysis of distorted linear array using interval methods
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: A mathematical model is developed to determine the effect on the radiated array pattern of distorted linear array caused by the tolerances on the array element position using the interval methods. In the model, according to the mathematical rules of interval arithmetic, the upper and lower bounds of linear array's power pattern can be analytically expressed as functions of interval values of the element positional errors. The tolerance studies are achieved with the expression to determine the effects of different interval values of the positional errors on the interval of radiated power pattern and its features such as sidelobe levels and beam width as well as pattern tolerance index. A series of representative results demonstrate the validity and potential ability of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Structural-electromagnetic coupling based least squares compensation method for active phased array antenna
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The complex operating environment could entail a significant degradation on electromagnetic properties of active phased array antenna (APAA), which has been proven as a barrier to improve the capability of APAA. Thus an effective compensation method is essential to ensure the antenna's properties. Based on the structural-electromagnetic coupling model, combined with the least squares method, the adjustment quantity of RF phase and amplitude excitation are obtained, which shall be implemented to recover a high quality pattern from a distorted antenna. A linear array of elements is analyzed based on this method to compensate the degradation of system performance resulting from mechanical vibrations. Numerical results show this technique permits to restore the steering direction, decrease the side lobes and eventually recover high quality patterns in all directions.

articleTitle: Output power dependence of piezoelectric nanogenerator under mechanical deformation
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Piezoelectric nanogenerators (NGs) harvesting mechanical energies have been getting attraction because of their advanced properties, such as continuous operation, low cost, and non-toxic operation. However, the most of research were focused on improvement of piezoelectric materials by applying chemical methods. In this report, we demonstrated the energy conversion efficiency(ECE) difference under different mechanical deformations, bending and twisting. Depending on the deformation conditions, strain distributions are critically changed, resulting in different output performance. For this research, we prepared ZnO-based PNG by sputtering. To understand the effect of external mechanical deformation on the ECE, we characterize the ECE by the ratio of output electrical energy and strain energy of ZnO active layer. To calculate the strain energy in ZnO active layer, we conducted numerical simulation of two mechanical deformations. Finally, we obtained that the ECE under twisting deformation is much higher than that under bending deformation. Our results could provide a design direction to PNG systems as high performance power generators.

articleTitle: A compliant translational joint based force/displacement integrated sensor
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The design methodology and validation of compliant translational joint based force/displacement integrated sensor is presented in this paper. The stiffness analysis of the large stroke and high precision compliant translational joint is developed, in which the screw theory based symbolic formulation method for structures is employed. By combining the stiffness matrix of the single compliant beams and components in this joint, the total stiffness matrix is derived. The stiffness matrix is validated by FEA method. Finally, The compliant translational joint was fabricated with a 3D printer and equipped with a linear position sensor and micro controller. The displacement of the translational joint is measured and then the force can be calculated by using the stiffness matrix. A calibration is conducted so that the sub-Newton precision of the sensor is achieved.

articleTitle: Multimode parameter fuzzy self-tuning PID precise temperature control system
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In this paper, lithography projection objective precision temperature control system is designed study. The system mainly consists of a PID controller, heating tanks, cooling module and circulation piping systems. To achieve ultra-precision temperature control, we studied the control algorithm and selected the multimode parameter fuzzy self-tuning PID control method finally. And we have built the experimental prototype to conduct the experiment that using other thermal load instead of the thermal load of the projection objective, the experimental results demonstrate that the system is stable and fast response, circulating water temperature can reach the set temperature in a short time and fluctuate within a range of ± 0.01 °C.

articleTitle: Structure design and thermodynamic analysis of a space-borne distributor
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Distributor is an important part of space-borne satellites, which can receive satellite commands, then allocate control the power of satellite antenna surface, meanwhile feedback its own control state to the satellite. In this paper, we illustrate the space-borne distributor in detail from the structural design, layout design, mechanical design, thermal design, etc., the analysis results of the space-borne distributor show that the design of the distributor to meet the requirements of the space-borne space environment. The design method and analysis procedure of space-borne distributor will provide a foundation to the structure design in the space-borne space environment.

articleTitle: Research on optimization design and experiment of the electronic equipment moveable cabinet
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of flexible handling & quick response in the situation of high-tech local war, combining the work condition and the structure characteristics of the electronic equipment moveable cabinet, under the condition of the reliable in the application, based on the analysis and research on the lightweight of the moveable cabinet by finite element analysis, several schemes, including integrative optimization, detail optimization, thickness optimization and process optimization are presented in this paper, and take a certain movable cabinet as example, an engineering verification of the results is made in this paper, and an good application effect is obtained.

articleTitle: Application research of Diamond/Cu in solid-state microwave power module
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Much focus has been placed on the thermal management of electronics in recent years. An overall reduction in size of electronic components as well as advances in chip technology, leading to ever higher power dissipation, have increased the necessity for innovative cooling designs. As a new generation of electronic packaging material, Diamond/Cu composites have excellent performances such as high thermal conductivity and adjustable CTE. In the present work, experimental studies have been conducted to reveal the feasibility of Diamond/Cu composites in industrial applications, and then the technical processing of its plating and welding was obtained. Moreover, the simulation tests of its thermal properties and harsh-environment-hardiness were conducted. The results validated that the use of Diamond/Cu in solid-state microwave power module's thermal design is feasible.

articleTitle: The application of immersed boundary-lattice Boltzmann method in vortex-induced vibration
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Aiming at vortex-induced vibration problem, immersed boundary-lattice Boltzmann method (IB-LBM) is adopted in the paper. In order to establish a baseline for comparison and verify the precision of the algorithm, a uniform flow past a rigid cylinder at Re=200 is simulated first and the numerical results are compared with the results of other documents. The motion of the elastic-supported cylinder is modelled by a spring-damper-mass system and the motion equation is solved using the Runge-Kutta method. The cylinder is only allowed to vibrate in transverse direction and the Reynolds number is kept at 200. Besides, the lift and drag coefficients of the cylinder, the displacement of the cylinder and the vortex pattern in the wake are extracted at different natural frequencies, and on this basis the dynamic response characteristic of the cylinder is studied. As the natural frequency reduces, the time history of fluctuating hydrodynamic coefficients characterized by `beating' is presented, and the phase between lift force and the crossflow displacement undergoes a change from the `in-phase' mode to the `out-of-phase' mode. The results further show that the cylinder oscillations could be as large as 0.53 diameter under certain natural frequency.

articleTitle: Study on effect of master DOF on errors of PCB substructure modal analysis
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: With the development of electronic technology, a large amount of electronic components can be installed on PCB, which have attracted more and more attentions from researchers to the vibration performance of electronic components and PCB. In this paper, firstly, the basic theory of substructure modal analysis method was introduced, and the main effect factor for modal analysis was analyzed by theoretical method and the error equation was deduced by nonlinear matrix perturbation method. Then, the FEM analysis of electronic components and PCB with plate and solid elements were performed to discuss the influences of element order of master DOF on errors. The results show that element order of master DOF of contact pair is main factor for computational errors, including high element order of master DOF can reflect the vibration performance of PCB more accurately, and the grid number, computation time are substantially reduced compared with the overall model. Therefore, the results are valuable to engineering application.

articleTitle: 3D wiring design of large phased array radar antenna based on Creo/cabling
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: With the improvement of integration of radar systems, radar structures become more complex, and in the design process of radar, the application needs of 3D wiring is more urgent. In the paper, we describe a more convenient method developed on the basis of the basic functions of the Creo software, which is more suitable for cable design of the radar antenna. The wiring method was verified in a large phased array radar antenna. Also, we summed up the conventional 3D wiring ideas, described how to use simplified methods of 3D wiring in antenna design of radar. Finally, the practice has proved that using simplified methods of 3D wiring can obviously improve the efficiency of 3D wiring and 3D wiring has played a significant role in guiding the actual production and assembly.

articleTitle: On tolerance modeling of plane featuer based on Small Displacement Torsor
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The mathematical model of tolerance is the foundation of the assembly tolerance analysis. In order to study the mathematical model of the plane tolerance, at first, the SDTI (Small Displacement Torsor with Interval) model of plane tolerance and the constraints of screw parameters were investigated, based on SDT (Small Displacement Torsor) model and interval arithmetic. And then, a new simulated method was presented to solve the problem that the traditional simulated process of feature does not take into account the constraints of screw parameters. This new method used fraction defective of the constraint equation to establish the distribution of the parameters. At the last, an example of plane feature was introduced to validate the new method. The results indicated that the new method was proposed in this paper improve the accuracy of simulation.

articleTitle: Three-dimension magnetic field analysis of an electromechanical converter
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Electromechanical converters (EMCs) are considered to be the most frequently employed linear motion mechanism in various industry fields. This study tries to improve the magnetic force characteristics of an EMC, focusing on the key component, permanent magnet (PM) of the EMC, different magnetization techniques of single PM and different magnetization array of multiple PMs are compared, and a novel EMC magnetized alone the external field force lines using 8 pieces Halbach array is proposed as well. The analysis on three-dimension magnetic field of the EMC shows that the magnetic force between the coil and the single PM increases by 36.07%, and the magnetic induction generated by the 8 pieces Halbach array arrives at the maximum value. Compared with a widely used array of 2 pieces radial array, the magnetic force of 8 pieces Halbach array is increased by 14.81%.

articleTitle: Uniform-tension form-finding design for cable-mesh deployable reflectors
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Space deployable cable-mesh reflector antennas are required to be tensioned in a self-equilibrated state through form-finding design. For this problem, an iterative design method is presented, which consists of two steps, one for the front net and the other for the rear net. First, the front net is designed iteratively with the combination of force density method and surface stress density method. With all the front net nodes on the ideal paraboloid, the tension of the cables and stress of the membranes are designed to be uniform. Second, according to the shape and tensions of the front net, the maximum tension ratio of the rear net is minimized with the tension ties remaining vertical, using the equilibrium matrix method. Numerical simulations indicate that the proposed method can effectively implement the from-finding design of cable-mesh reflector antennas considering both cables and membranes.

articleTitle: Anaylysis and design of integrative antenna cold plat based on tile modules
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: An integrative cold plat, which is employed in the thin profile section antenna array, is presented based on the tile T/R modules. In order to meet the integration, lightweight and thin profile of the antenna structure of the whole layout requirements, cooling performance analysis and framework structure design is carried out. The cold plate sample result shows that compression resistance good agreement with the design.

articleTitle: Development of layer-by-layer CNT thin film assemblies for volatile organic compounds sensing
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In this study carbon nanotubes (CNT)-based conductive polymer nanocomposites fabricated by electrostatic layerby-layer (LbL) technique were used as the sensitive gas sensors. The conductive layers were progressively built alternative exposing into sodium deoxycholate (DOC)stabilized CNT anionic and poly(diallyldimethyl-ammonium chloride) [PDDA] cationic solutions, respectively. By this technique the fine control of sensitivity to VOC was accomplished due to a fine tuning of multilayer films resistance (from 50 to 2 kΩ) by the precise control of layer thicknesses (from 5 to 40 nm). This study resulted that 16 bilayer PDDA/(CNT+DOC) LbL assemblies provided the optimum detecting and diagnosing performances of eight VOC vapors (i.e., chloroform, acetone, ethanol, water, toluene, dichloromethane, tetrahydrofuran and methanol).

articleTitle: Experiment and identify of deformed geometry of microchannel in LTCC and stainless steel
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper deal with the problem that how to identify the value of deformed microchannel in LTCC when the microchannel after the completion of the design and Manufacture. An optimization method (conjugate gradient method) was used to find out the deformed variables. A stainless channel was designed and the experiment validate the correct and accuracy of the method. Results obtained by minimize the error of the temperature between the measured points and the designed channel.

articleTitle: TOP-DOWN collaborative design for radar system
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The demand for collaboration between specialties is proposed in order to improve the efficiency of electronic products development. As for the structural design of radar system, a concept of TOP-DOWN collaborative design based on PDS platform is employed to realize coordinative development among various specialties and different departments. This paper mainly presents key points about procedures and specifications during 3D collaborative design by means of CREO 2.0 software on PDS platform. The discussion involves aspects of coordination system, framework model and process of collaborative product design.

articleTitle: Correlation of critical ambient heat load of an orbicular cover sheltering electronics devices
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The critical ambient heat load of an orbicular cover sheltering electronics devices was numerically studied with a view to identifying the effects of several parameters, including solar radiant intensity, latitude, geometrical and thermo-physical properties of the orbicular cover, and thermal parameters of the ambient. The results of various working conditions showed that the above mentioned parameters all had effects on the critical ambient heat load. To identify and quantify the effects of these parameters, the results were mathematically processed, and then a correlation of critical ambient heat load was obtained. With this correlation, the critical ambient heat load of electronics devices in any orbicular cover could be calculated quickly regarding to various working conditions.

articleTitle: Enhanced plasmonic effects in AG decorated amorphous TiO2 nanotube arrays
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In the present investigation SERS sensitivity and plasmonic-photonic interference coupling (P-PIC) in amorphous TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanotube (A[TNT]) and crystalline silver (Ag) nanoparticles was studied. TNT were synthesized by two step anodization on titanium (Ti) substrate. Using thermal evaporation, 20 nm Ag film overcoating on TNT structures was synthesized, which coalescence to form Ag nanoparticles, acting as a three dimensional (3D) surface enhanced raman spectroscopy (SERS) substrate for rhodamine 6G (R6G) molecule detection. The nanoarchitecture phase formation is confirmed by X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis, Raman spectroscopy analysis. Surface morphology and the salient features are studied by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Current decay time is also studied and compared for the samples respectively which show large current decay time for A[TNT]-Ag as compared to C[TNTAg]. UV-visible absorption studies shows larger red shift in the absorption band gap edge of A[TNT]-Ag samples as compared to C[TNT-Ag] samples. Moreover the TNT length variation in A[TNT]-Ag samples results into constructive or destructive interference, which in turn affect the P-PIC and R6G molecule detection as well as SERS intensity which was approximately three time higher than C[TNT-Ag].

articleTitle: Fine control of carbon-polyelectrolyte thin film sensors sensitivity for human motion monitoring
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Carbon nanomaterials have emerged as highly promising nanomaterials for recent thirty years. There have been numerous researches regarding potential applications of carbon nanomaterials due to their outstanding properties which originate from the network of sp2-hybridized carbon atoms. In this regard, it is also reported that a variety of functional composites or hybrid materials with carbon nanomaterials result in novel applications as well as synergistic enhancements in target properties. In this study, multi-functional polymer/graphene nanoplatelet multilayer composite films were fabricated by layer-by-layer assembly. Graphene nanoplatelets (GNPs), two-dimensional carbon nanomaterials provide not only excellent electrical conductivity but barrier property for gas molecules. Layer-by-layer assembly is a simple, inexpensive bottom-up techniques for multilayer film deposition with easy control of inner structures. In this study, transparent conductor for next generation flexible electronics was considered as a potential application of layer-by-layer assembled polymer/GNP multilayer composites films. GNP coating on thin polymer substrates was expected to be applicable to flexible display applications, while metal oxides such as indium tin oxide have a limitation due to its mechanical fragility. Thus, electrically conductive layer-by-layer assembled GNP films which shows gas barrier property as well as mechanical flexibility could be fabricated with low material and processing cost. Though thermal annealing and acid treatment on GNP films effectively lowered the sheet resistance of the films, their transmittance and sheet resistance still need to improve further to be used as transparent conductors for flexible display applications. Meanwhile, further efforts must be focused on the possibility of other applications.

articleTitle: The calculation of crystal acceleration sensitivity and study on coupling mechanism
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Crystal is the core component of electronic equipment, which has a clear multidisciplinary nature. According to the noise reduction of vibrating crystal in the application requirement, the necessity of the study on the vibration sensitivity about quartz crystal is explained, meanwhile, the definition, characterization and measurement methods is determined in the paper. The effects of various input conditions on the electrical properties of the quartz crystal are studied from the perspective of data mining. Optimization model is established to solve the acceleration sensitivity of direction in a variety of external perturbations.

articleTitle: Experimental research on the reciprocating-mechanically pumped two-phase cooling system
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: A completely new MPCL system was put forward in the paper and the experimental platform was set up. In the preliminary experiment, when the system was filled with different filling rates, the start-up and operating performance was study. The optimal filling rate was obtained. And meanwhile the conclusion was made that uneven heat source and insufficient drive capability of the pump lead to the poor performance of the system. So the experimental scheme was improved from these two aspects. Through the improvement of the heat source, the start-up and operating performance of the system alter for the better. Based on the optimized heat source, the drive capability of mechanical pump was improved. The system has shorter start-up time, lower steady-state temperature and smaller temperature fluctuation. The system also has larger heat load when it operates and has no temperature pulse when the heat load changes. In a word, the heat transfer capability of the system was improved greatly. According to the experimental research, the MPCL system can start up smoothly and operate safely. The equivalent heat transfer coefficient of the system can get very large and temperature uniformity of the system is very well. The experimental research has laid the foundation for further study.

articleTitle: A microchannel design for multiple heat source conditions
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is used to design a novel microchannel network for the application of nonuniform heat flux generated by electronic devices with multiple heat elements. The channel network includes three tapered headers and two channel-regions. A corresponding experiment system is developed which mainly consists of a computer-controlled pump, heating blocks and the apparatuses for measuring the temperature and pressure drop. The distributions of pressure drop, temperature, and the Nusselt number in the microchanel heat sink are provided as well as thermal resistance.

articleTitle: Adjustable water contact angle by nano composite structure with different thermal expansion
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The fabricated AAO has hexagonally arranged nanosize holes under specific conditions. Paraffin was filled in the holes of AAO. While the AAO is hydrophilic, paraffin is hydrophobic. In addition, the coefficients of thermal expansion (CTE) of AAO and paraffin are quite different. Thus, the composite surface becomes able to have different roughness at different temperature. The range of the CA on the composite surface was 63 to 113*. The CA increased as the temperature varied from 1 to 40°C. In the range of temperature, 1 to 40°C the result from the experiment shows very similar trend to the calculated result. The CA difference between measurements and calculations is very small and this is because the real AAO has a little roughness and theoretical roughness is totally flat.

articleTitle: Micro powder injection molded microchannel array
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Micro powder injection molding is one of the most important technologies in MST and MEMS industry due to its low cost, fine accuracy. For the purpose of obtaining micro parts with microchannel array of high quality and precision, manufaction of powders were carried out on micro powder injection molding. The influence of sintering temperature on the relative density, mechanical properties and grain size were investigated. The results show that the optimal performance of micro parts with microchannel array was acquired at the sintering temperature of 1500°C. Micro channels with good roundness and no obvious defects were successfully manufactured. The linear shrinkage of microchannels was nearly uniform with low dimension deviation. The size error can be controlled at 1.5% or less.

articleTitle: Attitude algorithm system design of quad-rotor aircraft based on STM32
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In this paper, a quad-rotor attitude algorithm system based on STM32 is discussed. This system uses a low-cost AHRS reference system to measure the attitude of aircraft, to merge data with complementary filter algorithms and PI control and to calculate the attitude with the data of gyroscope, accelerometer and magnetic by coordinate transformation. Experiments proved that the attitude algorithm system solved the noise interference and optimal estimation of attitude and achieved the requirement of steady, accurate and reliable data output for a long time.

articleTitle: Robust optimization of Powertrain Mounting System based on interval analysis
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Owing to the uncertainties of the manufacturing or installation errors, the real value of the Powertrain Mounting Systems (PMS) is always varying around its nominal value. These uncertainties will definitely deteriorate the performance of PMS. This paper proposes a robust design method based on interval analysis and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for the optimization of PMS. First, the uncertain parameters of PMS are represented by interval numbers. Then the decupling ratio and nature frequency of PMS are calculated by interval analysis. To obtain the compact interval of the lower and upper bound of the decupling ratio and nature frequency, a combined method based on interval analysis and PSO is employed in the paper. To illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, a case study is given. By using the proposed method, the decoupling ratio can be improved significantly while the constraints are well satisfied. In addition, the variations of decoupling ratio and nature frequency can be obtained simultaneously. Consequently, it is easy to see that the proposed method is effective and robust for the optimization of PMS.

articleTitle: Sensing characteristics study of fiber Bragg grating for nonlinear ultrasonic
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Ultrasonic defect detector which is based on linear ultrasonic technology has been widely applied in structural health monitoring now. However, its detection sensitivity is not high enough. Nonlinear ultrasonic method was proposed to improve it. On the other hand, fiber Bragg grating technology is being developed rapidly in sensing field and it has great advantage in distributed measurement. In this paper, a new system which combined nonlinear ultrasonic and fiber Bragg grating was built. The influences of some important parameters were discussed. The results proved the system can detect defect effectively and can realize distributed measurement easily.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis on the temperature characteristic of three type support beams in MEMS resonator structure
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: With the commercialization of micro devices, abnormal working environment, especially such as temperature, becomes the important factor that affects on precision and reliability of components. To verify the temperature variation regularity, this paper discusses and compares three types of MEMS resonators, whose movable structures are respectively supported by clamped-clamped beam, crab-leg beam and folded beam. The temperature test platform is built and the tests of typical temperature sensitive structure are conducted. The results show that under the effect of environmental temperature, the resonance frequency of three types resonators also increases with the decrement of temperature linearly. And the temperature sensitivity becomes higher with bigger rigidity of the beam. Additionally, stress relief capacity of folded beam is the best.

articleTitle: Precision evaluation method for the sub-reflector adjustment mechanism of Shanghai 65 meters radio telescope
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In this paper, the configuration of the sub-reflector adjustment mechanism of Shanghai 65 meters radio telescope is introduced, and the kinematics calibration is performed by the laser tracker for institutions. Secondly, based on the strong coupling characteristics of the parallel mechanism, a method contains a coupled repeated positioning accuracy information is proposed which is suitable for the parallel mechanism repeated positioning accuracy measurement and evaluation. Finally, according to the proposed repeated positioning accuracy measurement and evaluation methods, the uniaxial repeated positioning accuracy and spatial pose repeat precision of the adjustment mechanism of sub-reflector are measured and analysed. The results show that the repeated positioning accuracy of the adjustment mechanism of sub-reflector is high and is able to meet the requirements of the pointing adjustment precision of the sub-reflector of 65 meter radio telescope.

articleTitle: A fuzzy network method for the airfoil long baseline antenna deformation measurement
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The development of high-altitude long-endurance unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is receiving more and more attention, and a high precision deformation measurement in real time of the airfoil long baseline antenna is of great significance to ensure the antenna performance. According to the theory of fuzzy self-structure, a self-structuring fuzzy network deformation measurement (SSFNDM) which is suitable for the real-time measurement of the airfoil deformation is proposed to build a network to approximate the relationship between the strain and the displacement automatically. A deformation measurement experiment on the aluminum airfoil model under static load is also presented. The results show that the SSFNDM has a high accuracy and a fast speed for training to provide a new way for the airfoil deformation measurements.

articleTitle: A 3D printing flexure pressure sensor for robot impact safety testing
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper presents a flexure pressure sensor fabricated by means of 3D printing. This sensor combined with a biosimulant artifact from the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) is used to measure the severity of injuries caused in the case of a robot impact with a human. The stiffness matrix is derived for the structure by means of screw theory. A Finite Element (FE) model is constructed to verify the analytical model and obtain the allowable pressure with regard to the yield stress.

articleTitle: Design and characteristic analysis of a piezoelectric micro-jet generator
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Considering the lubrication failure of spacecraft, an original piezoelectric micro-jet device which takes the control moment gyro (CMG) as specific application object is proposed. The working principle of the micro-jet device was analyzed. The structure designs were illustrated detailedly. In order to choose a suitable working mode, modal analysis under the action of fluid-structure interaction was conducted, it showed that the first mode of piezoelectric vibrator is more desirable compared to other modes. Also the dynamics analysis of the piezoelectric vibrator was studied, the results revealed that the effect of the fluid should not be neglected when researching the characteristics (resonance frequency, vibration amplitude, etc.) of the micro-jet device; as the increase of the thickness of the piezoelectric ceramic piece or the metal diaphragm, the resonance frequency of piezoelectric vibrator increased, but the maximum vibration amplitude of piezoelectric vibrator decreased; as the increase of the liquid density, both the resonance frequency and the maximum vibration amplitude decreased obviously; as the increase of the liquid depth when the liquid viscosity is low or can be ignored, either the resonance frequency or the maximum vibration amplitude did not have much change.

articleTitle: Metrology system in the raidio telescopes
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: With the increase in and diameter operating frequency, the pointing accuracy and surface accuracy of radio telescope are also increasing. In order to achieve the specified performance, different types of instruments and techniques have to introduced to reduce the various components of pointing and surface errors. This article provides a brief discussion and introduction of large radio telescope metrology system.

articleTitle: A moisture detection system of iron ore concrete
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper presents a moisture detection system of iron concentrate used in seaport by microwave transmission method. By contrast, the detection system adopts pyramid horn antenna as the special sensor. According to the size of conveyor belt, one pyramidal horn antenna is designed and simulated in HFSS. With the simulation results, a pair of pyramid horn antenna is manufactured. In order to meet the requirements of moisture detection, we design one experiment. The experimental result shows that the proposed port microwave moisture detection system of iron ore concrete, the detection scheme is feasible, and by further improvement and on-site test, it is expected to be directly applied in seaport operation and thus it will be guiding signifiThis paper presents a moisture detection system of iron concentrate used in seaport by microwave transmission method. By contrast, the detection system adopts pyramid horn antenna as the special sensor. According to the size of conveyor belt, one pyramidal horn antenna is designed and simulated in HFSS. With the simulation results, a pair of pyramid horn antenna is manufactured. In order to meet the requirements of moisture detection, we design one experiment. The experimental result shows that the proposed port microwave moisture detection system of iron ore concrete, the detection scheme is feasible, and by further improvement and on-site test, it is expected to be directly applied in seaport operation and thus it will be guiding significant in improving the quality of Chinese imports of iron ore concrete.cant in improving the quality of Chinese imports of iron ore concrete.

articleTitle: Posture stabilization control of two-wheel drive electric motorcycle with assistant pendulum for rider motion
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Recently, global warming is the serious world problem. To solve this issue, many new vehicles appear today. For example, there is electric motorcycle (EM). In the almost conventional approaches, one inverted pendulum model for camber angle is used. This model does not include the rider motion and it is not good enough to consider stabilization of vehicle in the real world. So, this paper proposes a new EM system with assistant pendulum. Also, the proposed human camber angle disturbance observer (HDOB) considers compensation for stabilization of human camber angle. By these proposed approaches, the improvement of posture stabilization of whole electric motorcycle system considering rider motion is validated by the simulations.

articleTitle: Design of water cooling device and control system based on can bus
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper through the analysis and comparison of several existing field bus, and combined with the structure system of cooling system, designed for use of liquid cooling radiating mode and use the CAN bus as the system data transmission mode. The use of CAN bus real-time, strong anti-interference ability and reliable error handling and error detection mechanism makes the system can also operate safely and effectively in the on-board equipment conditions on the. The design has the advantages of low noise, high heat radiating efficiency aspects of a temperature measurement and control system with CAN bus technology and liquid cooling technology combined with liquid cooling. To solve the current cooling system of high noise, low heat radiating efficiency and bulky shortcomings. At the same time, discusses the design scheme of the liquid cooling system, system flow and system function, The method has high feasibility.

articleTitle: A new ultrasonic motor utilizing longitudinal vibration of sandwich type transducers
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This study presents and verifies a new idea for simplifying the frequency matching process of ultrasonic motor by constructing a new sandwich type ultrasonic motor, which utilizes the combination of the symmetrical and antisymmetrical longitudinal modes of mirror symmetrical structure. Two Langevin transducers in combination with two isosceles triangular beams are used to construct the stator. The superior point of the stator is that the frequency matching process can be neglected, because the resonance frequency difference of the two operation modes is very small, which is the characteristic of the symmetrical structure motor. The influence of the triangular beam structure on the vibration amplitude of the driving foot was analyzed. Driven by AC signals with the driving frequency of 55 kHz and voltage 400 Vp-p, the no-load speed and the maximal output torque of the prototype motor were 24.41 rpm and 7.84 N·cm, respectively. The motor is simple in structure, low cost in fabrication and feasible to implement linear or rotary movement of moveable body.

articleTitle: Design of a rotating hole-type sonic crystal structure for low-frequency noise reduction
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The characteristics of a kind of rotating hole-type sonic crystal(or phononic crystal) which can be designed to reduce low-frequency noise are discussed in this paper based on the experiment results. In the experiment, a kind of two-dimensional sonic crystal(SC) was applied to reduce the rotating structure noise in 0-2550Hz obviously and the maximum value of noise reduction reaches 25dB.This phenomenon couldn't be explained by the static model analysis. Therefore, a proper theoretical model is built to describe the impact of the interaction between rotating sonic crystal and the air around it. Dispersion relation of this equivalent model is obtained, which shows that the wave couldn't propagate in the range of 0-5400Hz. This phenomenon illustrates that the approximate band gap feature is existed in the low-frequency range. This kind of extremely low-frequency band gap is due to the combination of the vibration of a single air scatter and the interaction among scatters which are generated by the SC motion. Theoretical result fits the experiment data well. In general, for rotating machine noise control in low-frequency range, the wave propagation impediment phenomenon which is generated by SC structure rotating could be expected to be of great interest technically.

articleTitle: An assembly sequence planning approach for space assembled antenna
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: An assembly sequence planning approach of space assembled antennas is presented in this paper, based on simulated annealing algorithm. Firstly, the geometrical model of the shortest assembly path of `space station - arms - manipulator' system is constructed with the consideration of inherent radius. Then, the optimization model of assembly sequence planning is established, and the optimization objective, design variables and constraints are discussed, separately. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of the antenna sequence planning problem, simulated annealing algorithm is adopted to solve this optimization problem. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Electro mechanical coupling analysis ol structurally integrated antenna
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper proposes a coupling approach to investigate the effects of structural deformation on the performance of structurally integrated antenna. In this method, the deformed displacement of radiating elements is determined by using the modal superposition principle of dynamic mechanic equation. Subsequently, the deformed displacement is coupled to the radiated field equation of the antenna array. Finally, an electromechanical coupling model is built by combining the equations from two different disciplines. Some experimental devices are designed by utilizing a 2.5GHz structurally integrated antenna, and the results confirm the effectiveness of the coupling model. The validated model can been applied to investigate the influences of environmental loads on the mechanical and electrical performance.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sliding mode control of the a-axis with high torque and high power
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: For the influence of nonlinear backlash and friction on positioning precision of the A-axis in 5-axis machine tools, the fuzzy controller (FC) with gain auto-tuning and fuzzy sliding mode controller (FSMC) with gains auto-tuning are proposed. For the former, the control law mutation caused by gain switching in traditional fuzzy control is eliminated by introducing the gain auto-tuning based on the continuous exponential function of the error. For the latter, chattering phenomenon in traditional SMC is eliminated by employing the FC to approximate the nonlinear function item in the equivalent control law. Experimental results show that both the two control algorithms can achieve higher steady state precision and faster dynamic response with zero overshoot.

articleTitle: A form-finding approach of slack cable net based on elastic catenary element
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper proposes a form-finding approach of slack cable structure based on finite element method with elastic catenary element. Elastic catenary element is briefly introduced first. Then, the difference of form-finding problems between the prestressed and slack cable net is discussed, then the problem of slack one is transferred to an optimization problem. The optimization mathematical model is constructed and the solving strategy is presented. Finally, the simulation of a slack cable structure given in literature is operated. The comparison between the method in this paper and the one in literature verifies the validity and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A study on the Fast M-Estimation based Gaussian Filter controllable in robustness
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: A FMGF (Fast M-Estimation based Gaussian Filter) is the fast robust Gaussian filter that output wave pattern accorded mutually with the Gaussian filter output.. However, in some case, robustness of FMGF is less than Brinkmann's robust Gaussian filter. Then, robustness of the FMGF is strengthened. The FMGF has characteristic that robustness and output process is calculated in each x-coordinates. Using this characteristic, only few x-coordinate that is affected by outlier are recalculated. In the recalculation process, parameter m value changes to small value, and to strengthens robustness. Using characteristic of the FMGF that accords with output of the Gaussian filter, the outlier areas are judged. The first process of the new FMGF, executes the Gaussian filter and normal FMGF. Next, only x-coordinates that has deviation between output of the Gaussian filter and the FMGF are recalculated. It is confirmed that the robustness of the new FMGF is strengthened without problems.

articleTitle: Performance prediction for array antennas with element position error based on coupled structural-electromagnetic model
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The realistic array antennas are inevitably susceptible to mechanical manufacturing errors, external loads and high thermal difference, which result in the unexpected notable degradation of electromagnetic performances with the corresponding element position error, seriously restrict the development of high-performance array antenna. The element position error include random error and systematic error, and both are correlated. In this paper, an statistical analysis method based on the coupled structural-electromagnetic model of array antenna and Monte Carlo method is proposed to predict the combined impact of random error and systematic error on antenna performance. With the application of the proposed approach, the statistical properties of antenna performance are predicted. Furthermore, the critical value which random error can be ignored in the presence of random error and systematic error is obtained.

articleTitle: Mechanical design and analysis of a cylinder antenna array
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In order to make a large area survey, precisely measure a large scale space and detect dark energy, a large radio interference array with a large number of feeds is required. This paper presents a structure design of one cylinder parabolic antenna array. We establish the finite element model of cylinder antenna array of "Tianlai" plan, calculate and analyze the deformation of the antenna reflector under load of gravity, snow and wind. Simulation and analysis results show that the surface deformation of the antenna is small under various conditions;therefore, the structure is stable and reliable, which meets the design requirement.

articleTitle: REflector Antennas: The sidelobe sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Sensitivity analysis is an essential part in the error evaluation for distorted reflector antennas. The sensitivity defined as the gradient of sidelobe level with respect to surface nodal displacement is investigated. By dividing the reflector into a series of triangles, the partial derivatives of sidelobe level directivity with respect to surface nodal displacement are obtained. Simulation results show the sensitivity contour plots for an axis-symmetrical reflector and an offset reflector in the nominal state, and some conclusions are arrived.

articleTitle: Vibration analysis and design methodology for single-impact and double-impact triboelectric generators
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Remote low power devices that will constitute the internet of things can be powered by scavenging energy from environmental mechanical vibrations. Triboelectric generators (TEG) are devices that can be used to convert vibration motion into electrical energy. In this paper we explore how freely vibrating TEGs excited indirectly by external forces may be designed. The design of TEGs depends on several variables and application specifications. First the system is modeled and the related parametric variables are studied. A design algorithm is proposed to achieve resonance condition. Based on the algorithm single-impact TEG and double-impact TEG devices were fabricated and their vibration behavior measured. The double-impact TEG showed four times improvement in voltage output and two times improvement in operation frequency bandwidth. Finally, the proposed system model was simulated using MATLAB for the two TEG designs. It was shown that the simulation supports the experimental results.

articleTitle: Design and application of a new type combined shelter
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Shelter is the loading platform for the electronic equipment and the operator, the space of the traditional shelter can not satisfy the large-scale command post and the field hospital's requirement. An original combined shelter is introduced in this paper, which is composed of two lateral jointed expandable shelters, a common shelter, a passageway and a tent. It can be expediently extended by increasing the number of the compositive unit. The combined shelter can spread out rapidly and can be conveyed by each individual unit. Using this combined shelter, the improved interspace and carrying capacity can be obtained compared with common shelter.

articleTitle: Design of the radar antenna folding mechanism
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The mechanism can realize folding and automatic limit. Due to space limitation, how to realize the antenna unfolding and folding is a key for designing the antenna mechanism. At the same time as the finite element simulation analysis for key parts of the central axis, verify and bearing deformation meet the requirements of the contact position of rotation.

articleTitle: Initial shape optimization for ECDMA based on coupled structural-electrostatic theory
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The electrostatically controlled deployable membrane antenna (ECDMA) is a promising structure with many outstanding advantages, such as low surface density, large aperture and high surface precision. However, it is a huge challenge to describe the coupled structural-electrostatic filed between the membrane and electrode accurately. This paper applied nonlinear finite element method and the virtual work principles to obtain the coupled structural-electrostatic field governing equilibrium equations. Then the coupled model, a 5m diameter, f/2, curved membrane antenna finite element model was built in which the electrostatic force changed when the membrane deflection occurred. We simulated with this model, compared to the previous model using the parallel capacitor relationship and got some interesting conclusions: 1) the parallel capacitor relationship is not applicable when the membrane deflection and the gap are in the same order of magnitude; 2) the coupled structural-electrostatic field governing equation can be a enjoyable replacement of the parallel capacitor equation. Finally, based on the coupled model, we optimized the initial shape of the membrane and acquired a high precision membrane surface.

articleTitle: Fluid-solid coupling analysis of 65M radio telescope antenna
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In this paper, the essentiality of fluid-solid coupling analysis was addressed, meanwhile the basic principles and fluids of fluid-solid coupling analysis were presented. The fluid field of 65m radio telescope antenna was numerically simulated. The drag coefficient and wind pressure distribution under different wind directions were obtained. The simulated results compared with the wind tunnel experiment and the errors between them were analyzed. The solid field was simulated with the fluid field numerical simulation value, and consequently the stress field and displacement field were obtained. The result demonstrates that fluid-solid coupling method is an effective way for the antenna under wind field to develop engineering problem.

articleTitle: Thermal simulation and heat transfer optimization of electron equipment chassis based on FLOTHERM
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Effect of plate-fin parameters on the cooling of high heat flux electronic chips was investigated based on FLOTHERM. The simulation results indicate that the maximum temperature (T-<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>) decreases with the increase of base thickness (0.5-7mm) or the fin height (6-11mm). However, T-<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> first decreases and then increases by increasing the number of internal fins (30-60). The optimized base thickness, fin height and number of internal fins are 2.8mm, 9.2mm and 45, respectively. Moreover, copper plates between hot spots and heat sink base were used to enhance the heat transfer process sequentially. The results show that T-<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> decreases apparently by improving the heat transfer process near hot spots. In order to decrease the weight of heat sink, the optimized combination of base thickness and the height of copper plates (H <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">plate</sub>) were investigated. Considering the size restriction (H <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">plate</sub> + Base thickness=3.8mm), T-<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> first decreases and then increases with the decrease of base thickness (2.8-1.0 mm). In this study, T-<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> of the chassis with optimized PCB modules decreased by approximately 6 °C compared with the previous chassis. The simulation results in this study are referential for the design of electron equipment chassis.

articleTitle: On mathematical representation of part deformations based on actual working conditions
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Based on the basic theory of finite element, the part deformations under the mechanical load are calculated. By combining the theory of TTRS, we present the mathematical expression of part deformations. First we establish solid model of the part through three-dimensional modeling software. We also set material properties and divide the grid. According to the actual working condition of the part, we apply corresponding load for computation model. Finally we use finite element analysis software ANSYS Workbench to solve the part deformations under actual engineering conditions. The method is applied to the analysis of deformations for a gear shaft. The effectiveness of this method is also verified.

articleTitle: Cutting simulation of the curved pipe's intersection line based on UG and Vericut
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The intersection structure of curved pipe is widely applied in modern building; however, there are still many technical problems to cut the intersection line of curved pipe. This paper analyzes the complexity of this type of intersection line, and proposes a new solution to cut it. In order to verify the feasibility of the cutting, a five-axis linkage simulation of cutting is conducted in UG and Vericut software. The trajectory of cutting torch is planned and its cutting error is tested, then the moving pose of cutting torch is programmed by post-processor module in UG. One cutting equipment model is established in Vericut, a kind of multi-axis NC simulation software, and also the movement pose of cutting torch is simulated. The NC program has been verified by Auto-Differ module in Vericut. The simulation process will provide a theoretical guidance for the development of curved pipe cutting equipment.

articleTitle: Discrete variable optimization of reflector antenna with continuous method
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: In practical reflector antenna structures, components of the back-up structure (BUS) are selected form a standard steel library which is normally manufactured. In this case, the design problem of the antenna structure is a discrete optimization problem. In most cases, discrete design is solved by heuristic-based algorithm which will be computing-expensive when the number of deign variable increases. In this paper, a continuous method is used to transfer the discrete optimization problem to a continuous one and gradient-based technique is utilized to solve this problem. The method proposed can achieve a well antenna surface accuracy with all components selected from a standard cross-section list, which is shown by a 9m diameter antenna optimization problem.

articleTitle: Researches on the anti-shock capability of a ship-borne cabinet based on DDAM
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: After analyzing the dynamic equation, the modal participation factor and the method of modal synthesis are given. Then, according to the specific national standard, the ship-borne cabinet is computed and analyzed with ANSYS software based on the dynamic design analysis method(DDAM).The results show that the maximum equivalent stress of the cabinet is below the yield stress of the material, the impact force on the isolator is under its allowable value. The results also provide a valuable reference for the future optimization design.

articleTitle: Fabrication of typical 3D structure on LTCC for microsystem
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Multilayer LTCC substrate can fulfill circuit miniaturization; meanwhile, its “brick-laying” fabrication manner provides feasibility for complicated 3D structures. Based on the traditional fabrication technology, this paper introduces the novel fabrication methods for two kinds of typical 3D structures on LTCC. For microfluidic structure, we choose applicable graphite-based sacrificial material. By adjusting the laminating and sintering parameters, preferable results can be obtained. For membrane embedded cavity structure, we proposed “sandwich” method, in which the LTCC membrane is protected by the high-temperature sandwich material. In such regime, the constraint-sintering is realized. In addition, depending on the protection of the sandwich material, the LTCC membrane with the flatness about 15μm is realized in the embedded cavity. The realization of the two kinds of 3D structure in LTCC substrate is meaningful for LTCC microsystem applications.

articleTitle: Review on board-level photoelectric interconnection technology
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: With the improvement of the wiring density and the signal frequency, electrical interconnection based on the copper wire connection could not meet the need of Electrical interconnection. Board-level photoelectric interconnection is a new way of interconnection to solve the problems existing in the pure electrical interconnection. This paper introduced the definition of board-level optoelectronic interconnection technology, summarized the characteristics and basic principle and classification of board-level optoelectronic interconnection technology analyzed the board level photoelectric interconnection technology research status at home and abroad, points out that the board level photoelectric interconnection problems existing in the development, and prospected the future of board-level photoelectric technology development trend.

articleTitle: Modeling of surfaceerrors in multi-scale of the planar slot antenna
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: This paper presents the theoretical and experimental analysis of the surface errors of the planar slot antenna by using three different kinds of error models. An periodic function is presented to characterize the surface deformation on the radiation array plane, and then the Gaussian function is introduced to simulated the deformation of radiating slots. The roughness on the inner surface of the radiating waveguide is modeled by the fractal function. Three kinds error models are constructed by means of the Monte Carlo method based on the measured data. Finally, a prototype of the missile-borneplanar slot antenna is constructed and tested to verify the accuracy and efficiency of the presented methods. Comparison between the proposed modeling methods and the measured data shows that the proposed model is effective, which can provide the theoretical foundation for the control of the antenna surface-working.

articleTitle: Effects of random errors in different rings on reflector's gain and sidelobe levels
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: Effect analysis of the reflector surface errors on radiation characteristics is one important research topic. In this paper, a mathematical model is developed to describe the influencing degree of the random errors in different rings on reflector's gain and sideloble level (SLL). Then, based on the proposed model, through the analysis for the errors in different rings, the curves for the gain loss (GL) and the first sidelobe level increase (SLLI) are presented to show the effects of random errors in different rings on radiation characteristics. First, to show their correctness, several simulations with different non-uniform surface errors are presented. Then, a multi-objective optimization model is constructed to further analyze the effects of the errors in different rings. Some useful results have been obtained. Simulations show that the errors' distribution along the radius has an important effect on GL and SLLI, and the errors' non-uniformity should also be considered in the evaluation of the reflector surface.

articleTitle: Structure design of an outdoor solid-state amplifier chain
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: An outdoor solid-state amplifier chain consists of two separate units, amplifier and power supply, and this amplifier is core of the chain. Tough environment, high heat consumption and complicated EMC requirement are the main difficulties in the structure design. Cold plate, sealed and shielded package are used to solve all these problems, which are proved to be effective by both calculation and tests.

articleTitle: Research on virtual maintenance simulation tests for radars
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: As an important quality characteristic, the maintainability acts a direct relationship on the radars. Along with the develop trend of miniaturization in dimension and complication in performance, the roomage becomes smaller and smaller, which brings difficulties to the maintaining of radars. And it even happened that the product designed couldn't be maintained. So, we built a digital virtual maintaining platform and researched on virtual maintenance simulation tests. And then the parallel cooperation of design, manufacture and maintaining was realized, the digital virtual manufacture and maintaining was carried out. So, the conventional design and manufacture were upgraded prominently, the developing time was saved, the design defects were discovered, and then the abilities of radar development were elevated roundly.

articleTitle: Fabrication and design of solar cell based on textile
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: These days, renewable energy has been developed drastically because of the depletion of natural resources. One of them is solar cell, or photovoltaic cell. It has been extremely studied and received lots of attention for energy harvesting. As portable device has been given the attention, organic photovoltaic cells (OPV) have been rapidly emerging for the following-generation flexible power source due to their unique properties such as flexibility, light-weight, cost-effectiveness, and being environmental friendly. For these great reasons, OPV can be integrated on textiles. In this study, we developed an OPV based on textiles. In addition, we suggest design of the optimized photovoltaic textile and theoretical approach to determine the contact area on a textile electrode. By the results of calculation, we got about 13 mA cm-2 under 1 Sun condition, resulting in the PCE of approximately 2 % of the short circuit current density. We expect that OPV-clothes will be commercialized soon.

articleTitle: Research of the optimization design method based on the antenna array structure of a certain mobile radar
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The Top-down design method of a certain mobile radar antenna array is proposed in this paper. Using classical mechanics to solve the maximum stress and deformation of the antenna array in the static working condition is considered as the optimization constraint condition and the mass of the antenna array is the optimization object. Then the mathematic model is build. Using genetic algorithm to do the first optimization design, the initial structure parameters is obtained. By using APDL of ANSYS system to establish a parameterized finite element model further and considering the static condition and dynamic condition, the antenna structure parameters could be get in the second optimization. Top-down design is conducted in the design of a certain type of mobile radar. And the optimization result is compared with the existing result of this radar. It shows that the Top-down method in this paper is reasonable and the lightweight effect is obvious.

articleTitle: Availability evaluation of wind farms considering the influence of vertical wind shear
publicationTitle: Fifth Asia International Symposium on Mechatronics (AISM 2015)
abstract: The probability distribution of wind speed and availability of wind farms are investigated considering the vertical wind shear. Wind speed at extended height (60 m) was generated from that of reference height (10 m) through the Power-law Process.
